ga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative
ga.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses consist primarily of employee-related expenses, including salaries, benefits and equity-based compensation expenses for personnel in executive, finance, business development, investor relations, legal, information technology, human resources and commercial functions. Other significant selling, general and administrative expenses include facility costs not otherwise included in research and development expenses, legal fees relating to patent and corporate matters and fees for accounting, consulting services, professional services and corporate expenses. We expect selling, general and administrative expense to continue to increase as we support the commercial launch and ongoing commercialization of ISEMBYLD in the U.S. and continue to build infrastructure to support potential future launches in other jurisdictions, as well as in support of our research and development activities.

sga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative

nonop.heading: Other Income (Expense), Net
nonop.text: Other income (expense), net consists primarily of interest income earned on our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, offset by interest expense incurred on our debt facility, including amortization of debt discount and debt issuance costs.

net.text: Net cash used in operating activities was $234.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and consisted of our net loss of $322.6 million, partially offset by changes in our assets and liabilities of $22.5 million and non-cash adjustments of $65.9 million. The non-cash adjustments are primarily from equity-based compensation.

ocf.heading: Net Cash Used in Operating Activities
ocf.text:
Net cash used in operating activities was $234.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and consisted of our net loss of $322.6 million, partially offset by changes in our assets and liabilities of $22.5 million and non-cash adjustments of $65.9 million. The non-cash adjustments are primarily from equity-based compensation.

Net cash used in operating activities was $224.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, and consisted of our net loss of $287.0 million, partially offset by changes in our assets and liabilities of $4.6 million and non-cash adjustments of $57.8 million. The non-cash adjustments are primarily from equity-based compensation.

da.text: facility costs and other allocated expenses, which include expenses for rent and maintenance of facilities, insurance, depreciation and other supplies.

net sales.heading: Product revenue, net
net sales.text: On September 11, 2026, the FDA approved ISEMBYLD for the treatment of SMA in adults and children two years of age and older who are currently receiving SMN2-targeted treatment. We began commercial shipments of ISEMBYLD in the U.S. during the third quarter of 2026 and therefore began recognizing product revenue during the quarter. We sell ISEMBYLD in the U.S. to a specialty distributor, which resells the ISEMBYLD to qualified health care providers, and to specialty pharmacies, which dispenses ISEMBYLD for administration to patients. We record product revenue net of estimated variable consideration, including chargebacks, government and commercial rebates, discounts, distributor and specialty pharmacy service fees, copay assistance and estimated product returns. Product revenue during the launch period reflects sales to our customers, including inventory build within the channel, and may not directly correspond to patient starts, infusions or underlying patient demand during the period.

intro.text: We are a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to improving the lives of children and adults with spinal muscular atrophy (“SMA”) and additional rare, severe and debilitating neuromuscular diseases. As a leader in the biology of the transforming growth factor beta (“TGFβ”) superfamily, our novel understanding of the molecular mechanisms of growth factor activation enabled the development of a proprietary platform for the discovery and development of monoclonal antibodies that locally and selectively target the precursor, or latent, forms of growth factors. Based on our innovative, proprietary, and scalable technology platform, we are building a world-leading anti-myostatin pipeline. During 2025, we made significant progress in advancing our product candidates.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Other receivables
lines.why: Owed by suppliers and others, not by customers (vendor non-trade receivables): operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
